==Overview==
The '''AfreecaTV Starleague Season 7''' (아프리카TV 스타리그 시즌7) or '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League Remastered Season 7''', was an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[AfreecaTV]]. Qualifiers started in '''Seoul''' on 2019-01-05.<br>

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yb5yqHz3i1Q</embedvideo>

===Format===
* '''Round of 24 group stage'''
** [[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Round of 16 group stage'''
** 12 players from the Round of 24 join the four seeds from [[AfreecaTV Starleague Season 6]]
** [[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one
** Top two players in each group advance

* '''Elimination Stage'''
** Eight player single-elimination bracket
** Quarterfinals through finals: best-of-five
